issues.summary: Accepted large positive Delta overflows the request deadline and falsely confirms live peers dead at time zero
issues.property: Config.Validate accepts positive Delta; protocol sections 1, 3, and 7 require accurate death facts and request timeout only after complete sending plus 2*Delta
assumptions: Valid immutable command at original coordinator
OBSERVE sends complete at time zero; deliveries may legally occur later within Delta
Zero crashes and no elapsed time

reproduction.command: GOCACHE="$PWD/.runtime/go-build" GOTMPDIR="$PWD/.runtime/tmp" GOPROXY=off go test -count=1 -v -run TestAcceptedDeltaDoesNotExpireAtZero ./audit/repro
reproduction.observed: Exit 1: 250ms control passes; large Delta marks b and c dead and Fast-decides at now=0 with fault=nil

issues.polarity: PASS means no unexpired request is treated as timed out; FAIL means premature death confirmation or decision
